# PropertyBrain

> Free UK property investment calculators — instant, no signup, no paywall. Covers buy-to-let yield, stamp duty (SDLT/LBTT/LTT), mortgage repayments, rental yield, serviced accommodation (Airbnb), HMO yield, capital gains tax, property flips, refinancing and portfolio disposal, all built for UK tax rules (including Section 24).

PropertyBrain.uk is operated by EIGHTFINITY LTD (company no. 15528515, England and Wales), which also operates [PropertyAlert.uk](https://propertyalert.uk/) — a live UK property deal-sourcing platform with 46,000+ listings, yield analysis and planning alerts.

## Calculators

- [Buy-to-Let Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/buy-to-let-calculator/): Gross yield, net yield, monthly cashflow, Section 24 tax impact and 5-year projections for a UK rental property, with a personal vs limited company comparison.
- [Stamp Duty Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/stamp-duty-calculator/): SDLT (England), LBTT (Scotland) and LTT (Wales) — standard, additional-property and first-time-buyer rates, kept current against 2026 bands.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/mortgage-calculator/): Monthly repayments, total interest cost and full amortisation schedule for repayment or interest-only mortgages.
- [Rental Yield Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/rental-yield-calculator/): Gross and net rental yield plus monthly income after management, maintenance and void allowance.
- [SA / Airbnb Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/sa-airbnb-calculator/): Serviced accommodation cashflow with occupancy sensitivity, comparing SA returns against standard buy-to-let.
- [HMO Yield Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/hmo-yield-calculator/): House in Multiple Occupation gross yield, net yield and monthly cashflow across multiple let rooms.
- [Property ROI Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/property-roi-calculator/): Total return, annualised ROI and cash-on-cash return combining cashflow and capital appreciation.
- [Cashflow Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/cashflow-calculator/): Simple monthly income vs expenses breakdown for a quick property cashflow sense-check.
- [Capital Gains Tax Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/capital-gains-tax-calculator/): UK CGT liability on a property sale at 18% or 24%, with annual exempt amount and Private Residence Relief.
- [Property Flip Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/property-flip-calculator/): Net profit on a buy-refurbish-sell project including stamp duty, bridging finance, CGT and selling costs.
- [Refinance vs Sell Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/refinance-vs-sell-calculator/): Compares net cash from remortgaging to release equity against selling the property outright.
- [Portfolio Disposal Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/portfolio-disposal-calculator/): Plans CGT-efficient disposal of up to 5 properties across tax years to maximise annual exempt amounts.
- [Bridging Finance Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/bridging-finance-calculator/): Models bridging loan cost, interest and exit for short-term property finance.
- [Section 24 Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/section-24-calculator/): Compares personal vs limited-company tax treatment of buy-to-let mortgage interest under Section 24.
- [Refurbishment Cost Estimator](https://propertybrain.uk/refurbishment-cost-estimator/): Estimates refurbishment budget for a buy-refurb-sell or buy-refurb-refinance project.
- [2027 Landlord Property Income Tax Calculator](https://propertybrain.uk/property-income-tax-2027-calculator/): Models the incoming 2027 changes to UK landlord property income tax.

## Free downloads

- [Free Excel Downloads](https://propertybrain.uk/free-tools/): BTL cashflow tracker, property deal analyser, portfolio tracker and SA income calculator spreadsheets.

## Templates and guides

- [Investor Guide](https://propertybrain.uk/guide/): How to use PropertyBrain's calculators for UK property investment decisions.
- [Deal Packaging Agreement](https://propertybrain.uk/deal-packaging-agreement/), [JV Agreement](https://propertybrain.uk/joint-venture-agreement/), [R2R HMO Agreement](https://propertybrain.uk/r2r-hmo-agreement/), [SA Operator Agreement](https://propertybrain.uk/sa-operator-agreement/), [SA Compliance Checklist](https://propertybrain.uk/sa-compliance-checklist/), [Scope of Works Template](https://propertybrain.uk/scope-of-works-template/), [Landlord Accounts Template](https://propertybrain.uk/landlord-accounts-template/): free UK property investment templates and checklists.

## Other languages

Every calculator is also available in Chinese (`/zh/`), Arabic (`/ar/`), and Hindi (`/hi/`).
